scripts.ui-chrome:qa: cross-env ENV=qa npx Playwright test ui/end-to-end.spec.js --project=chrome
scripts.ui-firefox:qa: cross-env ENV=qa npx Playwright test ui/end-to-end.spec.js  --project=firefox
scripts.all-browser-smoke:qa: cross-env ENV=qa npx playwright test ui/end-to-end.spec.js  --grep "@smoke" --grep-invert "@sanity"
scripts.all-browser-sanity:qa: cross-env ENV=qa npx playwright test ui/end-to-end.spec.js  --grep "@sanity" --grep-invert "@smoke"
scripts.all-browser:qa: cross-env ENV=qa BROWSER=All npx playwright test ui/end-to-end.spec.js
scripts.chrome-browser:qa_CI: cross-env ENV=qa BROWSER=All HEADLESS=true npx playwright test ui/end-to-end.spec.js --project=chrome
scripts.test:chrome:qa: npm run ui-chrome:qa && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:chrome:qa_CI: npm run chrome-browser:qa_CI && npm run allure:generate
